headline: Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse Erupt With Rapid Base Exchanges
war_summary: Violent base contestation has reopened across Stonecradle and the Weathered Expanse, shattering the midday stalemate on both central fronts. Stonecradle became the war's primary flashpoint over the past two hours, logging five rapid base transitions across World's End and The Reach while consuming nearly twenty-six hundred casualties. Simultaneously, the Weathered Expanse resumed intense territorial turnover with three base transitions split between Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, propelled by the front's highest bloodshed of over twenty-seven hundred dead in two hours. Further east, the Stlican Shelf rekindled after hours of quiet, suffering two base transfers around Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost amid sharply accelerating casualties. In Linn of Mercy, active base clashes continue with two fresh transitions leaving one redoubt neutralized, even as its casualty tempo cools from morning peaks. Callahan's Passage is mobilizing aggressively, recording fifteen hundred casualties in two hours under steepening losses, whereas Mooring County, Nevish Line, and the Dead Lands have lapsed into complete operational pause.
